verdict.rationale: Riveter is a web scraping, search and enrichment API, so a managed remote browser sandbox is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence pack documents only programmatic scrapes (URL to text), searches and AI agents that interpret pages. Nothing describes an interactive, manually driven remote browser session, so these features are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can access a managed remote browser sandbox for interactive, manual browsing workflows
